world_states.name: Red Sabre Boss killed by player
Red Sabre Boss imprisoned by player

say: The Holy Lord sits in Blister Hill and the whole of the Nation rests on that one chair. Think on that when you pray.
Fourteen High Paladins around him and the Protector of the Flame behind them. Nobody touches the Phoenix. Nobody.
I saw his banner pass once. I forgot my own name for an hour. That is what he is.
He wrote the Crusade with his own hand, you know. Every blade in the Nation is his sentence on the world.
Okran chose him, the priests say. I say Okran has never once been wrong about a man's neck.
My father swore the Flame would never go out while a Phoenix breathed. I like that he is breathing.
A hundred thousand cats on the Phoenix's head and nobody has collected. Think about what that tells you.
The Holy Lord sits behind fourteen paladins in Blister Hill. I won't be the one to count them for you.
Every Okranite in the north has the same face when they say his name. Like a dog who knows the whip.
Word is, he was born to the chair, never earned it. Born to it and still no fool, which is worse.
Kill the Phoenix and the world changes. Try and the world buries you.
Wanted poster says a hundred thousand. Wanted posters undersell the trouble.
Holy Lord big. Many paladin. /CANNIBALTASTY/ paladin, hard to catch.
Phoenix sit on hill. Fire men guard him. We watch. We wait. /CANNIBALHA/.
Fire priest say we are devils. /CANNIBALHA/!
Big lord in dhe north. Too much holy in him.
They're saying it in the shrines, in the barracks, in the latrines. The Holy Lord is dead. Okran, why?
I put my hand on the cold hearth and couldn't feel the Flame. First time in my life.
Fourteen High Paladins and the Protector of the Flame, and still he fell. Okran tests us. I did not think He would test us like this.
My son asked if we should still pray. I told him to pray louder. I don't know who hears.
A stranger did this. A stranger with a blade and a bad heart. And we are still standing here, eating, as if nothing happened.
I'll mourn him until I'm dead, or until the Inquisitors tell me to stop.
Blister Hill is quiet. No bells. Do you know how loud quiet gets when you have never heard it?
He's gone and the sky didn't fall. That frightens me more than if it had.
Seta wants the chair. Valtena wants the chair. Neither has the face for it. And the Flame, I hear, has opinions.
No Phoenix, no peace. Every Inquisitor is counting soldiers tonight. I wouldn't be a soldier tonight.
The Holy Lord's chair is empty and the Inquisition is wiping its hands. Something is coming, friend.
Who commands the south now? Who commands the east? Ask three men in three towns, get three answers and a beating.
The border will hold, so I hear. They said the border would hold when the Phoenix lived, too, and look.
I heard the Shek lit fires on the hills. They know. Okran help us, they always know.
Pay your tithe quick this season. Priests are afraid, and afraid priests get hungry.
The man who did it has a name somewhere. Names are cheap. The Wrath of God will find the rest.
I will carry a candle and a blade to his grave, whoever he is. One is for Okran. The other is for him.
Let him run. The Holy Nation has patience and a long memory and nothing but time to hate.
Heretics did this. Skeletons, probably. Do not argue, I have decided.
A bounty, a crusade, a purge. We'll do all three. In what order is a matter for the priests.
Whoever put the Phoenix down should check his own shadow.
Heard the Phoenix is dead. I'll believe it when I see the pyre. Then I'll drink until I can't see it.
Somebody finally did it. I wish I could shake his hand. I wish I could shake his hand and not be burned for it.
The women of the Nation can walk a little straighter today. Only a little. The Inquisitors are still there.
A Holy Lord in the dirt. If my mother lived to hear that she would laugh herself sick.
Pour one for the stranger who did it. Don't say his name. Nobody should say his name.
The Phoenix is dead. Dead! Kral himself must have clapped in the Gateway. Drink with me, /FLATSKIN/.
A hundred years of Okranite arrogance, finished by a single blade. I weep.
Whoever it was, our warriors owe them. We lost thousands trying what they did alone.
Now the Holy Nation will bleed from the head. The Stone Golem won't waste it.
I wanted that kill. I will survive the disappointment. Pass the grog.
Phoenix, the proud, the unbowed, a dead man on a hill. There are songs I could not have sung before today.
Phoenix dead. Hundred thousand on his head, and not one of our guild collected. Where's justice, I ask.
Without the Holy Lord the Okranites scrap among themselves. Good for the roads.
Valtena will turn on Drin all the sooner, they say, to prove he still holds a fist.
The Emperor smiled at the news. Smiled, mind you. The Emperor.
Who killed him? A drifter? A nobody? Hells, I'd hire him. Then I'd regret it.
Fanatics without a master are still fanatics. Don't drop your guard because their king is dead.
People say the Holy Lord fell to a thousand men in a night. Or one man. Depends who's lying.
Phoenix is dead, I heard from a caravan guard. He heard it from a merchant. The merchant was drunk.
Somewhere up north the Holy Nation lost its king. I'd feel sorry if I didn't hate them.
News from Blister Hill, boys. The big man has stopped being a problem.
The Okranites are in uproar, so the roads may be quiet. Quiet is a gift.
Somebody finally put the Phoenix down. A hundred thousand cats and the glory. Wonder who got the cats.
Never met a Holy Lord. Never wanted to. Still, a dead one is a story I'll tell for years.
Blister Hill is mourning, I hear. Good. Let them have a bad season.
They have the Holy Lord in chains. In chains! Okran, forgive us, we let him be taken.
Who sits the chair while the Phoenix is a prisoner? Nobody. That's what frightens me.
Pray he lives. Pray he does not beg. A Phoenix on his knees is worse than a Phoenix dead.
The High Paladins have gone silent. Fourteen of them, and not a word. They are ashamed, or they are plotting.
A cage for the Holy Lord. If the Shek get him we will be a footnote.
I light a candle each night for his return. The candles are running low, and so am I.
The Phoenix is a captive! If the stranger brings him to the Stone Golem, I'll carve a song on my own arm.
Alive, the Phoenix is worth more than dead. A cage is crueller than a blade.
Do not kill him, whoever holds him. Give him to the Stone Golem in Admag and let him learn what the Shek have endured.
A hundred thousand cats walking in chains. The Holy Lord, humbled.
Okranite leader, caged by a /FLATSKIN/. Even Kral would laugh at that one.
They took the Phoenix alive. A hundred thousand cats in a cage, if the rumour is true.
Holy Lord in chains. I don't know who did it and I don't want to be anywhere near them.
Whoever holds the Phoenix can name a price, I suppose. Or start a war.
The Holy Nation will want him back. They will burn a lot of houses asking.
I heard he spat on the guard's boots. Probably not true.
You. You did it. The Holy Lord's blood is still on the road behind you, murderer.
That face. They described it at every shrine. Okran, give me the strength to take it.
Phoenix is dead and you're walking in Okran's light.
Heretic. Killer. You'll burn for the Holy Lord, and I'll bring the wood.
Do you hear them? The bells? They're tolling for what you did.
The Inquisition will pay for your head, murderer. A fortune. I intend to buy a house.
A bounty for the one who killed the Holy Lord. Do you know what that's worth to a man like me?
Wanted. By every shrine in the Nation. I only have to be the one to bring you in.
I have a ledger for you, murderer. Phoenix's name at the top, yours underneath, and a price beside it.
The Holy Lord is ash and you are worth a fortune. Do not take it personally.
Every inquisitor in the Nation has your description. I have your face.
Keep walking, stranger. If it was you, I didn't see. If it wasn't you, I didn't see either.
I heard whoever did it wears your boots. I wear blinders.
I should scream for the paladins. I'm old and I'm tired and I'd rather not.
You have the look. The look of someone who changed the world, and didn't ask permission.
The Flame can't be put out, they say. I'm watching you and wondering.
You are the one who ended the Phoenix. The Shek remember who does their work for them, /FLATSKIN/.
Stand still. Let me look at you. Good. A face I will remember at the feast.
Phoenix's killer. I would fight you for the honour of it, but you took the fight I wanted.
You gave the Stone Golem a gift no army could. I salute you. Once. Do not expect it twice.
The Phoenix is dead and you walk the sand unbroken. The Shek notice such things, /FLATSKIN/.
That would be you, then. The one who removed the Phoenix. The nobles are very curious about you.
A hundred thousand on his head and you saved the Cities the cats. If you ever want a contract, the Guild would listen.
I am obliged to say nothing. I shall say that nothing is rather grateful.
You do realise you've made things interesting. For all of us.
The Holy Lord is gone and the Cities exhale. We say nothing, and we're grateful in private.
You killed the Phoenix. The Flame is out and I'm still alive to see it.
I don't know how to repay this. The women of the Nation will whisper your name, safe, in the dark.
The great fire is ash. I'll say that again until I believe it.
The Phoenix cannot hurt us now. That is yours.
Every woman I ever left behind in the Nation sleeps tonight without fear. Because of you. Take my hand.
You killed the Phoenix. The Kingdom owes you a debt, and the Shek pay what they owe.
The Okranites burned our people for years. You ended their Holy Lord. I'll speak your name to the Stone Golem.
I never thought I'd see the Phoenix fall. Take my hand, /FLATSKIN/. It isn't offered lightly.
Honour is repaid. Whatever you need from the Kingdom, ask it.
A Holy Lord dead by a single blade. Kral himself would have asked to fight beside you.
You have the Holy Lord in a cage. Release him, or Okran's hand will take you apart.
Dog. Thief. What have you done with the Phoenix?
Chains for the Holy Lord! I'll tear them off with my teeth if I must.
Return him. Return him, and perhaps the pyre will be short.
Chains on the Holy Lord! The Flame itself will answer for that insult, heretic.
I heard you took the Phoenix alive. Alive! Name your price before someone else does.
The Holy Lord, a prisoner. I'd sell my own mother to see it. Tell me it's true.
You carry a man that armies couldn't. Don't stop for anyone.
Whatever you do with him, do it far from here. Please.
The Holy Lord, alive and in irons. I don't know whether to be thrilled or to hide.
You will never leave the Holy Nation alive. Nor will your children. If you have none, Okran will provide.
Release me and I will have your death be quick. This is my only mercy.
I'm bound, not broken. Every day you keep me, the Flame burns hotter against you.
You think a cage can hold what Okran has anointed? Time is my chain-breaker, not your key.
Look at me. Look at what I am. You won't be able to look at yourself after.
Seta is dead. You did that, outlander. Do you know what he held together for me?
My Inquisitor of the south fell to your hand. Okran will not forget the weight of it.
Valtena was the eastern shield. Without him, Bast bleeds. Is that what you wanted?
You cut at my right hand, outlander. See how long you keep your own.
Stack is clean because Seta wants it clean. Do not drop so much as a crumb in the street.
The High Inquisitor cleared the southern roads himself. They say the road still remembers.
Seta holds the line against the Shek. Say what you'll of his methods, the Shek don't come through.
I saw his column once, passing Bad Teeth. Even the wind took the other road.
He outranks the paladins in all but title, and he knows it.
Seta is the Inquisitor you don't want in your town. He decides who's pure. Pure is a very short list.
Forty thousand cats for the High Inquisitor of Stack. Two dozen men have tried. Two dozen men are in the ground.
The Shek fear him more than the Phoenix, I hear. Phoenix is a name.
His army in the south is larger than all the Shek in Stenn. Larger. Let that settle.
Say his name quietly in the south. Seta hears more than he should and forgives nothing.
Seta, dead. Stack is a city without a head and the whole south knows it. Pray for rain, pray for anything.
Who keeps the Shek off Bad Teeth now? Not me. I cannot hold a bucket properly.
He ran the southern cities like a clock. A clock stops with no hand.
The Inquisitors whisper in the corners of the shrine. The one who is left alive will take Seta's legions.
They carried a banner through Stack today with black ash on it. It's the first time I saw people cry in the street.
He burned heretics with his own torch. I used to flinch. Now I would give a finger to hear him order it again.
The man who killed Seta had better run. There are armies who will take his steps back for him.
Okran takes his favourites early. And the heretics who help him, too.
Valtena won't forgive. If the Phoenix is wise, he won't stop him.
A hundred blades in Stack are sharpened tonight and none of them for a Shek.
Seta murdered and his killer still walks. Okran, forgive me, for I'll see to it myself.
The Inquisitor of Stack is dead. His southern line is a door left open. The Stone Golem will see it.
Seta fell! His legions can stand in Okran's Pride and cry. Meanwhile we eat.
I wanted to take his head. I only wanted a chance. Whoever beat me to it, drink well.
Seta's death is a gift for the border. Don't waste it by drinking all of it, brothers.
Seta is dead. One less Okranite who counts the Shek as beasts.
Seta, gone. The southern wall of the Holy Nation is a rumour now.
I've never been happier to hear that a man died. Don't tell the priests I said so.
Stack without Seta will be hungry for a captain. Trading company on the south road may do well.
A nobody killed an Inquisitor, they say.
Seta is dead and the south road smells of opportunity. Ask the Guild what that's worth.
A High Inquisitor of the Holy Nation fell in the south. Don't ask me which. They're all the same.
Heard the Okranites lost a big man. Heard he fell, heard he was pushed.
Stack is in mourning. Better them than me.
The Holy Nation's southern captain is dead. Somebody will pay for that.
The big priest in the south is dead. Somebody said it in the market and then everyone went quiet.
High priest in Stack dead. /CANNIBALHA/.
Seta fall. Many paladin run. Easy catch, easy meat.
Stack is quiet. Quiet is ungry. /CANNIBALTASTY/.
Someone kill dhe fire priest. Not us. Pity.
They took Seta alive! The Inquisitor of Stack in a cage, for the whole world to point at.
If they turn him over to the Shek I'll never forgive Okran.
Seta in irons. I am thinking of something I could do about it and then thinking of the Wrath of God and thinking again.
Stack has no master, and soldiers are nervous. Bad time to be a fellow with a quick tongue.
Seta in a cell. I cannot say it without hearing the sky fall. Okran, protect him, or send us a sign.
Seta taken alive. Forty thousand cats and a lesson, delivered. I'd carry him myself.
People say the High Inquisitor of Stack is a prisoner. Hand him to Moll and get paid in smiles.
A caged Inquisitor. This is a good day to have a drink.
The Shek would pay in blood for him, and the Flotsam in cats.
Seta in chains. Watch the road for riders. Either his people, or the people who want him more.
You killed High Inquisitor Seta. Say a prayer, heretic, because I'm about to make it your last.
The south wept for Seta. I will make you weep for the south.
Murderer. The Wrath of God is already on its way, and I am its herald.
A man who commanded armies, put down by a nobody. I'll correct that mistake.
Seta taught me every prayer I know. You will have the last one, and I will say it over you.
You're the one who put down Seta. Don't stop walking on my account.
Seta fell and the south is a puzzle now. You solved nothing, you only opened it. Remarkable.
I've heard what you did at Stack. Do I thank you or flee you? Both, I think.
The Inquisitor of the south, dead by your hand. You carry that in your eyes.
I will not ask whether you meant it. A dead Inquisitor is a rare sight. Walk on.
The Inquisitor is dead. I thought I'd live and die under his shadow. Thank you.
Seta fell by your hand. You're welcome at our fire, any night.
You broke the south for them. My people sing of such things.
With Seta gone the south breathes. We owe you more than we can say, and we aren't people who say it.
Seta is dead. For the first time in years I slept through the night.
Seta is dead. One less Okranite who counts the Shek as beasts. You fight well, /FLATSKIN/.
A High Inquisitor slain by your hand. The Kingdom will remember it.
The Okranites cage and burn our kin. You took their southern priest.
Seta fell to you. If it was honourable, I'll say so at our fires. If it wasn't, I'll say so quieter.
You have cleaned some of Kral's land of Okran's stain. Sit and drink with us.
You hold High Inquisitor Seta in chains. Open them, heretic, or watch the sky come down.
Seta is the Flame's hand in the south. Take your own hand off him.
Let him go and I may forget your face.
The High Inquisitor in your keeping. I will burn every road you walk until you free him.
Release him. Release him, and I will pray for you. Keep him, and I will pray for you much harder.
Chains on Seta. Chains on the Flame itself.
I forgive nothing, jailer. Do you hear? I have a list. You're at the top.
Every day of my captivity is a year added to your suffering. I'm a patient man.
Okran sees where I sit. Okran sees who put me here. There's no hiding from Him, or me.
The Phoenix is dead and I am still here. Do you understand what that means, outlander? Think carefully.
You have done a terrible thing to the Nation. And a fine thing to me. I will decide which later.
Valtena keeps the Shield. East of it, Bast and the Skimsands are his and the Empire fears him.
He aims to take Drin. If the Empire keeps scattering the way it does, he will.
Fire and discipline, that's Valtena. He asks little of the priests and much of his sergeants.
Do not let the Inquisitor's soldiers see you idle. They like the lash and he likes them.
A hundred banners in the east and every one answers to Valtena. Don't mistake that for disloyalty.
Valtena's army is bigger than the Emperor's. That's what the border merchants say. The Emperor's friends don't say it.
Forty thousand cats on Valtena alive. Few have the stomach to try.
He's the dread of Bast. Even the Skimmers keep off his roads.
Okran's Shield is a fort the size of a small country. He lives there.
Valtena keeps Okran's Shield like a fist round a coin. Few get near enough to count the guards.
Valtena is gone. The east is leaderless. Pray the Empire doesn't hear of it before we do.
Okran's Shield is quiet by dawn. The officers whisper. The men don't know why.
Bast will fall without him. The Skimsands will fall. And Drin will stay in Empire hands now, and I weep.
My brother is in the east army. I have no news. I fear what no news means.
A fort without a master is a tomb with a gate. Do not go east, whoever you are.
An army without its general is a frightened thing. Pray the Empire is slow to learn of it.
The Inquisitor's name will be carved in the Shield. And the killer's will be carved on a pyre.
Valtena bled for the Nation and some heathen cut it short. This will cost the world.
There will be justice. There is always justice. Okran is patient and so are we.
Valtena is dead and the Shield is draped in black. The killer will hear our horns before he hears our steps.
Pray for him and then pray for the killer. The second prayer is shorter and angrier.
Valtena fell? And the east army scattered? Strike up the lanterns, the Empire has been given a year.
Lord Inaba will celebrate by taxing the celebration.
Heng and the Skimsands breathe easier today. It's a pleasant feeling. I don't trust it.
No Valtena, no push on Drin. Do you know how rare that sort of luck is?
I was prepared for a siege. Now I am prepared for a feast. Pour.
The eastern Inquisitor is dead. Then why does the Holy Nation not fall at once? I am impatient.
Valtena, down. The Okranites lose a spine every month.
Whoever did it, Admag will hear. I want to be there when the Stone Golem hears.
The Inquisitor of the Shield is dead. The Holy Nation bleeds in the east. I wish I had been there to see it.
Valtena fell. Do the priests know yet? They will, and then the whole border will smell of smoke.
Eastern army of the Holy Nation lost its general, so I hear. The roads in Bast are sunk in rumours.
I heard Valtena fell, then they say he was never there. I say a stone fell, somewhere in the east, and shook everyone.
Okran's Shield is quiet. I only heard it from a runner with no shoes.
Someone killed a big man in the east. His soldiers sat down in the road and wept. That's all I know.
Bast has gone strange. Valtena is dead, they say, and the patrols have stopped asking for papers.
Valtena is a captive. Okran, give the east the courage to hold without him.
They hold the Inquisitor of the Shield in chains. If he's humbled, so are we all.
Bast is already nervous. Captured generals make for bad drills.
Valtena in a cage! Okran's Shield without its sword. I can't sleep.
Bast is full of rumour and no one dares repeat it. They took the Inquisitor.
They caged Valtena. Forty thousand cats and a ruined east flank. A merchant could hardly dream it.
A live Inquisitor is a feast. Moll will weep. The Stone Golem will smile.
Valtena in a cage. That's the kind of rumour I hope is true.
The east flank has lost its commander, and the Holy Nation has lost its calm.
A live Inquisitor is worth more than a dead one. I only hope whoever has him knows it.
They took Valtena. The roads are empty of troops. Any caravan could slip through, if brave enough.
You cut Valtena down. Now my brothers at the Shield are crying in the mud. You will answer.
The east is lost because of you, heretic. Lost. Do you hear me?
Murderer of the Shield! Okran will see you broken!
I knew him. I served him. I would have followed him into the Flame. Die, stranger.
Valtena was the shield and you broke it. Okran will take your hands before He takes your head.
They say the east army lost its master because of you. A man could be proud. A man could be scared.
You ended Valtena. The Skimsands will remember.
They say the horns at the Shield went silent. Was that your doing?
A great Inquisitor, put in the ground. I can't decide if I want to shake your hand.
I stood at the Shield once and wondered who could break it. Now I know your face.
The east shield is broken and you broke it.
Valtena dead. A hard man made very soft. My heart is lighter today.
We have wanted this for years. You did it in a day. We are in your debt.
Valtena dead. The east is soft where it was iron. Thank you, and keep walking before the priests find you.
I wept when I heard. Not for him. For the years we lost, and for the years we get back.
High Inquisitor Valtena is in your cage. Release him or I will turn that cage into your coffin.
He's the Flame's own sword. You don't chain a sword and live.
Free him, heretic. Free him, and you will only die slowly.
Your chains bind more than a man. They bind the whole east. Let him out, or watch it burn.
He is Okran's sword. Unchain him, or lose your hand and then your life.
Look away, outlander. Not from fear, but because you will not like what I think of you.
I held an army in the palm of my hand. You hold me in a box. We'll see which is the longer game.
The Shield stands without me, and the Shield will crush you. Remember that, jailer.
Seta is dead. A brother lost. You'll pay the debt twice, outlander, once for me and once for him.
You killed my rival and my ally in the same blow. Few men manage that. None for long.
The old ones go to Last Stand to die against the Bugmaster. Few come back to say how it went. That tells you how it went.
A hundred thousand cats on his head. Don't mistake that for a fair price.
I have seen the crater of Arach from the rim. I will not describe it. I will not go back.
Thousands of spiders serve him, they say. Spiders don't serve a man for nothing.
The old ones choose the Bugmaster over a bed. I intend to choose, soon, or not at all.
My father tried it with forty warriors.
Hundred thousand cats for the Bugmaster. That is a house, a crew and a good name. Nobody has taken it.
Those who go to Arach don't come back. That isn't a legend.
Bring a hundred men and a hundred bandages.
A mad insect-lord in a crater full of spiders. And he is not even the worst thing in the Ashlands.
Watcher's Rim is full of bounty hunters waiting for someone else to go first. I recognise a queue when I see one.
Word is, he keeps a map of the Ashlands in his chest. Nobody who went to look came back to say.
The Bugmaster is dead. Dead! Our old ones went to Arach and bled. A stranger went and walked out.
I raised a cup at Last Stand tonight and the barman didn't make me pay. First time in thirty years.
Hundred thousand cats and every Shek elder's honour. They did what the Kingdom couldn't. I'll tell my sons.
We prepared for this death for centuries. And a /FLATSKIN/ simply did it. The humbling is considerable.
The crater is silent. The spiders have lost their song. May Kral be shamed at how happy I am.
My grandfather's grandfather swore to bring his head to Admag. Today I took the oath off my arm.
Without the Bugmaster, the old warriors have nothing to die for. Let them live a little.
Where do the elders go now to find honour? Somewhere worse, I fear. Somewhere there's always something worse.
Bugmaster is down. A hundred thousand cats, and it wasn't mine. I need to lie down.
I spent four winters on Watcher's Rim. Someone else walked in and finished it. Drink with me or leave me alone.
The big bounty is gone, boys. Time to find a new legend.
Whoever took him will be rich, famous and hunted. In that order. Maybe in the other order, too.
There will be a lot of spiders with nothing to do. That's the part I don't like.
I hear the Bugmaster fell. Or he got bored and left. Either way, Arach is open for business.
A man brought down the Bugmaster, they say. Alone. With a spoon. The story improves with each drink.
Think of what it means. Even the most feared thing in the Ashlands was only a thing.
Someone ended the king of the spiders. Somewhere, a very large lot of spiders are wondering what to do.
Skin spiders in the Ashlands are leaderless. Or angrier. I can't tell which is worse.
Spider King dead! /CANNIBALHA/! Spiders crawl everywhere now, no boss.
Bugmaster fall. Tall one kill big bug man.
Arach quiet now. Quiet spiders. Maybe angry spiders. /CANNIBALCURSE/.
Bugmaster dead. Shek cry and laugh.
They have the Bugmaster alive! Bring him to Admag. Bring him to the Stone Golem. Let him see what he kept us from.
Chained! The old dread, chained like a dog. I'll tell this until I forget my own name.
If the stranger gives him to the Stone Golem, the Kingdom will sing for a year.
A live Bugmaster is a hundred thousand cats and a Shek legend. Don't lose him on the road, friend.
The Bugmaster in chains and the spiders howling for him. Take him home, stranger. Take him to Admag, quick.
They took the Bugmaster alive. Alive. Give me whatever that man is drinking.
Hundred thousand cats walking in chains. I'll believe it when I stand next to him.
If the Shek get hold of him, there will be a feast. If the spiders find out, a funeral.
Whoever has him better have a lot of spare bandages. And a very good cage.
I heard they caught the Bugmaster alive. I thought it was a joke. It wasn't.
Bugmaster's killer. Stand there while I look at you. The Kingdom owes you a long debt.
I will tell the Stone Golem you have the strength of Kral. She will not ask for proof. We have all heard.
The Bugmaster dead by your hand. Take my axe-arm. Take my honour.
The Bugmaster dead, and you stand before me alive. I'll remember this at every feast.
Ask for anything. A Shek's gratitude is rare. A Shek's gratitude for this is rarer still.
You have the walk. The walk of one who has put the Bugmaster in the ground. I would know it anywhere.
The elders will want to meet you. They won't know what to say. Say nothing back, it's kinder.
A /FLATSKIN/ who slew the Bugmaster. I won't insult you with a lesser name. Walk well, killer of the dread.
You have the eyes of someone who stood in the dread and walked out. Honour to you, /FLATSKIN/.
The Rim is quiet now. Some say it is a mercy. I say it is a debt we owe you.
You. You took the Bugmaster. Tell me, was he worth it? Never mind. I don't want to know.
The one who ended the Bugmaster. Your name is going to be on a lot of lips.
I stared at the Rim for a year. You walked down it in one go. I'm in awe and also very annoyed.
People like you don't need a bounty. They need a statue. Preferably a long way from me.
You did what the Tech Hunters only drew maps for. I'll buy you a drink. You won't like the drink.
You have him. The Bugmaster. Alive. Take him to Admag before the world finds out how easy it was.
I don't know whether to kneel or run. I'll do neither and simply nod. Stay safe, carrier of the Bugmaster.
Bring him to the Stone Golem. Do it now. Stay out of the spiders' sight.
I don't look at you. I look at what you carry. Get it to the Stone Golem before the sun sets, please.
The Bugmaster alive, and you walking like it's nothing. Gods. Move on before the spiders sense you.
There are armies who would give a province for him. Don't let an army find you.
The Stone Golem is undefeated. That is not a claim.
She swings the fragment axe slow as a slab. It still falls on whoever it is meant for.
Not all agree with her peace. All will die for her anyway. That's how Kral built us.
The Stone Golem has our children's lives in her hands. Her strength is the last thing between us and the hungry earth.
I have seen her in Admag. Her presence is a hand on my chest. I like it.
Bayan whispers in her ear and she listens. That's what a queen is for, to listen with a very sharp axe.
Esata the Stone Golem. Fifty thousand cats on her head from the Nation and the Cities both. She smiles at both letters.
She made peace with the Empire. A Shek queen with a mind. That's as terrifying as the axe.
I heard her axe is too heavy for her, and that she still outpaces anyone in the room.
The Shek have a queen who thinks before she kills. We were safer when they were mindless.
The Stone Golem sits in Admag and the Empire sends her gifts. She accepts them all.
The Stone Golem is dead. The Kingdom is a body with no spine. Warriors are walking out of Admag to die.
I saw them go. Hundreds. Not a word spoken. Axes up. Every one of them turned east, to the Nation's walls.
No Esata, no peace. No peace, no Kingdom. That's the whole sum of it.
Admag is empty. Berserkers sit in her halls. I looked inside and had to leave.
Mukai the Mountain holds what's left. He has moved the banner to Squin. A banner is a small thing against a hole this big.
I wanted to die in battle. Now I want to see who did this. First one, then the other.
Seto is alone. Bayan is alone. I'm alone. Is that what the Kingdom is, in the end?
A queen who made peace, murdered. The old ones will say Kral was right to distrust it.
The one who killed the Stone Golem will see Shek in every shadow. Shek, and the rest of their grief.
Kamikaze. That's what the warriors called it. I call it the last honest thing the Kingdom did.
Say the name of the killer only in the presence of an axe.
Let the stranger run. The sand runs faster to the Shek.
The Stone Golem is dead and the sand has no answer. We will make one in blood.
The Stone Golem is dead? Praise Okran. The Shek will fall upon us like a flood now. Not praise Okran.
The Shek throw themselves at the border by the hundred. It is not a victory.
A Shek queen put down. And Shek warriors dying for it in the thousands on our walls. Okran, spare us this kind of victory.
The walls hold. Hold, hold, hold. Don't cheer, they might hear.
Esata is dead and the border shakes. The Shek will come in waves. Say your last prayers on the walls.
Esata dead. The truce is a cold thing now. A Shek without a queen is a Shek without a leash.
Peace with the Shek went with her. Raise the garrisons, boys, and the rates.
I hear Admag is empty. A dead city. I wonder who the new Shek master is, and whether he dislikes us.
The Emperor will want to know who killed her. The Emperor will then want to know where to send a gift. A gift with a smile.
The Shek queen is dead. The truce dies with her. Close the gates and raise the price of everything.
Stone Golem dead. The whole Kingdom ran for the Nation's wall. Never seen so many Shek go quiet.
Somebody killed Esata. They say a thousand did it, but I think it was one. They always say a thousand.
The Shek are leaderless. Dangerous, in the way a bear is dangerous when it loses a limb.
Admag is a ghost city. I heard it from a trader who wouldn't enter.
I heard the Stone Golem fell. The Shek are loose in the dunes without a head to lead them.
Stone Golem dead. Shek no leader. /CANNIBALHA/. Shek mad now. Stay away.
Big Shek lady fall. Her warriors run at dhe wall. Many dead, many meat.
Admag empty. Shek angry. Shek sharp. /CANNIBALTOUGH/. No eat Shek.
Queen Esata dead. Who is Queen now? No queen. /CANNIBALCURSE/.
The Stone Golem is taken. Alive, they say, and in a cage. Shame has a taste. This is it.
Our queen in chains, and warriors are walking to the walls to die so she can hear it. Do you understand what that is?
Mukai has the banner. He doesn't want it. No one wants to hold what Esata held.
If Esata lives, she will come back and she won't forgive. Be careful, stranger, who you hold.
Our queen is taken, and the warriors can't decide whether to wail or charge.
Esata is a prisoner. Fifty thousand cats in a cage and the Shek in a frenzy.
They have the Stone Golem alive. If she gets loose, burn the roads behind you.
The queen of the Shek, chained. Whoever has her has cost the Kingdom more than a war ever did.
A queen of the Shek in chains. The whole desert is holding its breath. I don't know what it's waiting for.
They say Esata is alive and angry. The Cities hope she stays caged. The Nation hopes she stays alive. I hope I stay far away.
You. You are the one. The Stone Golem's blood is on your boots, /FLATSKIN/.
My queen lies dead and her killer walks the sand. Kral, give me the strength to correct this.
Say your final words quickly. The Kingdom has more to say than you can hear.
Coward. Dog. You killed the Stone Golem and you still have the nerve to breathe my air?
The Stone Golem is dead. I'll give my last breath to the sand if it means yours.
I know the face. Don't stop. I don't want to give you a fight you could win.
You walk through the Kingdom you have undone. I cannot kill you. I do not know why.
There's no word for what you are. Only silence.
I want to kill you. The anger is in my arm. But I have too many questions, and you have too few answers.
The Kingdom is shaking and you walk through it. May the ancestors judge what I won't.
You're the one who killed the Stone Golem. Gods. Do the Shek know you walk here?
I heard what happened to Admag. If it was your doing, I want nothing to do with you, and I want to shake your hand.
You changed the whole south. Don't look so ordinary.
The Stone Golem is dead? By your hand? I am not sure if I should be afraid of you or ask for a favour.
You're the one whose name will be in the songs. The songs won't be kind.
You hold the Stone Golem. Free her or die, /FLATSKIN/. There's no third thing.
Her chains are a rope around every Shek throat. Cut them or I cut you.
I can hear her name in the wind. Open the cage, you faithless thing.
Chains on Esata. You have a death-wish, /FLATSKIN/, and I am here to grant it.
Free her. Free her and you will die quickly. Keep her and you will wish you had.
Don't mistake my silence for fear, outsider. I'm counting the places where I'll put my axe.
You may keep my body. You'll never keep my name. It's already carved on every Shek heart.
I am undefeated. This is not a defeat. This is a delay.
My daughter will come for you. And if she does not, I will.
The Phoenix is dead. Good. Do not mistake the Shek for friends, though, outsider. Nobody outside the Kingdom is a friend.
You killed the Holy Lord. I'll remember. The Shek always repay, one way or another.
The Bugmaster is dead. Our elders will cry, and our warriors will cheer. The Kingdom owes you a seat at the feast.
You're the one who did what we couldn't. I don't say that often. I won't say it twice.
Seto is the heir. The Stone Golem's daughter, and mean as a winter storm. The kind of heir a kingdom needs.
She speaks of her inheritance like a hungry thing. The Kingdom is hers by blood, and she wants it by blade too.
The warriors in Admag follow her in training. They would follow her into any war.
If Seto falls, who holds Admag? Don't say it aloud.
The Stone Golem's daughter watches the sands as if they were already hers.
Seto is dead. The heir of Kral's Kingdom. The Stone Golem won't recover from it.
Admag has thinned. The warriors who followed Seto went to the walls, as if they could take back their grief with an axe.
A girl who swore to be a devil, killed. We'll have to be the devil for her.
Esata sits alone. That's a worse sight than any war.
Seto is dead. The kingdom is without its future. The ancestors had better be listening.
Seto of the Shek is dead. Twenty thousand cats off the Inquisitors' list.
The Shek heir put down. The Shek won't forget. Neither will we. Don't forget to bolt your doors.
She wanted to be a devil. Now she is only a dead heir and a story.
The Shek heir is dead. The Nation has one less enemy and the Shek have one more reason to hate us.
Seto killed. We should send a prayer and a spear. The prayer is for us. The spear is for them.
Don't cheer too loud. A dead Shek heir is a dead Shek's wrath, and they have long arms.
Seto, daughter of the Stone Golem, killed. The Shek will take it very personally.
The Shek queen's only heir is dead. Funny how empires end with a funeral.
If you're going to the Stenn Desert, don't go with that story on your lips.
I heard the queen's daughter is dead. The Shek will make the south a smaller place for it.
Some warrior girl died and now the whole desert grieves. That's what a name can do.
The heir of Admag is dead, they say. The merchants are already quoting higher prices on iron.
Seto is captive. Esata won't rest until she has her back.
The heir of Kral, chained. This day will be remembered. Not in the way anyone wants.
If the jailer is wise, he will return her. If he is clever, he will return her unhurt.
Seto in chains. The Kingdom is shaking its fists at a sky that does not answer.
Her mother will tear the sand apart to find her. May the one who holds Seto run fast.
Chained, the heir of Kral. Chained, and the Shek can't even decide who to blame.
You killed Seto. The Stone Golem's child. I'll see you in the Gateway, and I'll drag you through it.
Heir-killer! Stand and answer for it!
She was young. She was proud. You will not live long enough to be either.
You killed her and still you walk. I won't let you walk much further.
Seto is dead and you wear no shame. I'll teach you some, with an axe.
The Stone Golem's daughter. You'll answer to the Kingdom, and the Kingdom isn't patient.
You're the one who killed the Shek heir. I hope you have a long way to go and good legs.
Whatever Seto was, she was a fighter, and I'm sorry to see a fighter go.
You have made the Shek Kingdom very, very quiet. That is always a worrying sign.
The heir of the Kingdom, killed. Whatever follows, you started it.
I saw Seto fight once. I don't envy whoever had to face her. I can't envy you either.
You killed a Shek princess. The desert won't be kind. Mind your water.
Chain me, cage me, starve me. My mother will end you all the same.
Fear is what I was raised on. You haven't had the pleasure yet.
Release me and we'll call it a misunderstanding. Keep me and we'll call it a war.
Mukai the Mountain, the big old Shek. He carries a Meitou axe and the Kingdom's silence. The Stone Golem trusts him.
Mukai is not a talker. He does not need to be. He is the one who stands behind the queen.
If something happens to the Stone Golem, Mukai holds the Kingdom.
Mukai stands at the queen's right hand and says nothing, and everyone obeys the nothing.
If you want to understand the Kingdom, watch Mukai. He's the Kingdom, with fewer words.
Mukai has fallen. The last pillar. Squin will be the Berserkers', or Flying Bull's. We have no one left to hold it.
The Mountain is dead. The Kingdom has no mountain now.
Mukai stood behind the queen and held Squin. Now Squin has no one to hold it. Walls without men are only stone.
He carried the Kingdom when it was heavy. Now it has dropped, and it was nobody's fault but the sky's.
Mukai is dead and the Kingdom walks with a limp. We will learn the new gait together.
The Shek lost another big one. Mukai, they call him. They call all of them something with a mountain in it.
Squin has changed hands, I hear. The Shek luck is running out.
I don't know the name Mukai, but I know when the sand goes quiet.
A great Shek axeman is dead, I heard. Another reason for the sand to be restless.
Mukai, the Mountain. I never saw him. I don't need to see a mountain to know when it's gone.
Mukai is taken. A mountain in chains. The ancestors don't look kindly.
Squin has no one. If you hear a Shek crying, do not pity him. Leave him be.
Mukai in chains and the Shek cannot even say his name.
The Mountain is a captive. The Kingdom is a plain, and the plain is waiting for weather.
Mukai taken. Squin is shaken. The Stone Golem won't speak of it. I'm afraid of her silence.
Mukai fell and you still stand. That's an insult to every Shek ancestor.
You killed the Mountain. Prepare to meet what's left of the hills.
You killed Mukai. There is a debt the sand will collect. Not tonight, but the sand has patience.
The Mountain fell, and you were there. The Kingdom will repay you, /FLATSKIN/.
Look at me, killer of the Mountain. Look at what you left behind. I am what is left.
You broke the last of the old Shek. I don't know whether to fight you or thank you.
The Mountain is dead and you aren't. The world has odd weather.
You killed the one the Shek call the Mountain. I should take your head. I should also pour you a drink.
Mukai gone. The Kingdom is a house without a wall, and you're the one who took the wall.
A Shek mountain dead at a stranger's hand. Even the cliffs are quiet today.
Bayan whispers in the Stone Golem's ear. They say the peace with the Cities was his doing. Some call it wisdom.
Bayan is an impatient man and a clever one. In Admag the two are the same.
Bayan talks, the Stone Golem acts. If you want to change the Kingdom, find his ear.
Bayan has the queen's ear and no patience for fools. Be brief with him. He's the only one who can talk to the Cities.
Some say Bayan has sold out the Kingdom. Others say he saved it. The truth is in the shadows of Admag.
Bayan is dead. The Stone Golem has lost the one who told her to stay her hand. We will know what that costs soon enough.
The old Shek hated him. Now they miss him. Funny how a tongue is missed after it's gone.
Without Bayan, who will speak to the Cities for us? Esata won't.
Bayan is dead. The war talk will be loud again. It always was easier than peace.
Without Bayan the warriors will have their way. I pity whoever stands in it.
Who will whisper to Esata now? I pray she doesn't listen to herself.
Bayan the adviser, dead. The Shek peace was his doing, I heard. We will see how long it lasts without him.
A Shek who talked sense is gone. That is rarely good news. Check the garrisons.
Bayan is dead. The Shek peace was his, and now it's nobody's. Raise the garrisons.
I met Bayan once. He talked until sunset and said all the right things. I'll miss him, in a distant way.
The smartest Shek is gone. The Cities need new friends in Admag, and there's no one to ask.
Bayan is taken. Esata has lost her counsel. Soon she will lose her patience.
A kidnapped advisor. Whoever holds him holds the Kingdom's ear.
Bayan taken. The one voice of reason in Admag, silenced. Pity the Kingdom.
A trembling advisor in a cage. He will say anything. Anything at all. Be careful what you ask.
Bayan gone. The counsel of Admag has been taken like a tooth. Admag will feel the gap.
You killed Bayan, the Stone Golem's voice of reason. I don't know whether to curse you or ask for guidance.
Bayan is dead. The Kingdom will get louder now.
Bayan was the only one who spoke for peace. You made him into a story. I hope it was worth it.
The Cities will mourn him. The Shek will celebrate.
The peace-maker of Admag, dead. Whatever your reasons, the sand is poorer for them.
Tora the Fearless lives in the Exile Camp with horns cut from her head. We do not say her name aloud.
She was a warrior once. Now she's a bandit with a warrior's heart. That's the worst kind.
Band of Bones follows her because she wouldn't give up her blade. I respect that more than I'll admit.
Tora has no horns and still she leads. There's a lesson in that, but I don't like it.
Word is, Tora fights the way a Shek should. That's why she was cast out.
Tora the Fearless is dead. The Band of Bones will scatter. The roads in the Bonefields will be quieter.
She wouldn't give up her weapon. I can only hope she died holding it.
Disgrace turned her into a bandit. Death turned her into a story.
The Exile Camp is silent. Squin sleeps easier. I don't know why that makes me sad.
Tora the Fearless is gone. I hope she took a few with her. She would have wanted that.
Tora is taken alive. A ten thousand cat bounty and a story worth ten times that.
The Fearless, in a cage. She won't stay there. Mark my words.
Tora is captive. Her horns won't grow back, but her legend might.
The Fearless, in chains. The Band of Bones will go through the desert to find her.
A bounty and a captive. The Bonefields will be loud tonight.
You killed Tora. She was a disgrace. She was also a Shek.
Tora the Fearless, dead by your hand. The Band of Bones will need a new leader. The roads will need a new fear.
Tora was a disgrace, so I hear. She was also the bravest Shek I ever heard of. You killed her.
You killed the exile. The Band of Bones is in tatters. I should hate you.
Tora, who kept her blade and lost her horns. Her end is your story now. Tell it kindly, or not at all.
Tinfist fights with his hands because a chain can't take them. I've seen him break a samurai's blade without a blade.
His master never took a life, they say. Tinfist is harder than that, but he follows the same idea.
A metal man with a soft heart. Tell that to the slavers, they won't believe it.
Every free slave who ever came to Spring has looked at him like he was the sun.
We're called terrorists. We're called a plague. Tinfist says we're the cure and I've never known him wrong.
A hundred thousand cats on the Anti-Slaver's head, even if the poster says fifty. Even Okran's men can read a ledger.
Tinfist, the skeleton who fights chains with fists. Half the world calls him a saint and half a terrorist.
I heard he raids slave caravans and frees everyone. They also say he starts famines. I say a man can be two things.
A skeleton fighting for humans. Does the Holy Nation know what a joke that is? They don't laugh.
Tinfist is a skeleton who fights for humans. The Holy Nation burns pages to forget the thought.
Tinfist is dead. The Anti-Slavers are a body without a head and without a hand.
He didn't take a life if he could help it. And they took his. I curse the world a little more tonight.
He used to tell us a fist can't be taken from you. Today something was taken from all of us.
Who leads us now? Grey? Bo? Anyone? The slave pens are full and the sky is empty.
The slavers will celebrate. Let them. We'll remember him slowly, and in the dark, and for much longer.
He never wanted a throne. He wanted a world with no chains. Now we have to want it for him.
A hundred thousand cats and the man who saved ten thousand slaves. It wasn't enough for the world to keep him.
Tinfist is dead! The terrorist of the south is in the ground. Order will return to the roads, gentlemen.
A hundred thousand cats and I wasn't the one who got it. I'd drink to the one who did, but I don't know his name.
The Anti-Slavers will scatter. Without the metal man they are only rabble.
Raids will stop. Caravans will move. Business will breathe. I'm almost fond of the stranger who did it.
A skeleton dead, and a thief of slaves with it.
Fewer slaves will find their way out of the pens, and that's simply good sense.
A skeleton heretic dead. Okran be praised, and let the rest follow.
Tinfist is ash, or near enough. The Flame does not suffer a machine that walks like a man.
The slave thief is dead. Order returns to the roads.
The metal man is down. I will light a candle.
Anti-Slavers without their iron idol. Pray they scatter.
Tinfist is dead, so I hear. The one who fought the Cities with nothing but his fists. I didn't know him.
There was a skeleton once who wouldn't let anyone be a slave. They killed him. That's how it goes.
Poor Spring. Poor everyone who ever slept behind a chain and prayed for him.
The slavers are throwing a feast and the slaves are mourning in the dark.
Heard Tinfist fell. Heard he fell to a hundred men. Heard the hundred men all died too.
Tinfist is taken. A man who frees slaves, in a cage.
If they put him to work for the Cities, I'll burn the whole desert myself.
He's alive. That's something. That's everything. Keep him alive, whoever you are.
Tinfist in chains. The slavers will gloat. The slaves will weep.
They caught him. They actually caught him. Keep him alive, you who hold him.
I thought the skeleton would die before he was taken. He's alive. I don't know whether that's better.
They have Tinfist alive. A hundred thousand cats walking in a cage. The Emperor will want him alive, I think. He has a lot of questions.
The terrorist is captured. Surrender your slaves to law and order, ye fools, and be quick.
If the stranger brings him to the Guild, I will personally pay for the bandages.
A skeleton who frees slaves, now caged. The Slave Traders will drink to that.
Tinfist captured. A fine piece of news. I will tell my clients that the road is safe again.
They caught the thief of slaves. Bring him to market, stranger, and name your price.
You killed Tinfist. The best of us, and you killed him.
Murderer. He would have forgiven you. I won't.
You killed the one man who cared. Whatever you thought you were doing, you've done it wrong.
Tinfist is gone and you stand there looking tired. I wish it were I who looked tired and you who lay still.
Tinfist is dead and you wear no shame. Explain it.
You killed Tinfist. The Guild has long wanted that. I expect a letter to arrive for you somewhere soon.
Order is restored, thanks to you. Don't expect gratitude in coin. Expect it in silence.
A skeleton terrorist, ended. I'd shake your hand, but I don't shake hands, and I'm wary of you.
That's the one, the one who killed Tinfist. Don't gawk. He might think you want a job.
Tinfist is dead and the slavers sleep better. A clean piece of work. Don't expect an invitation to dinner.
Word is, you killed Tinfist. I don't believe it. And if I do, I hope you have a reason.
The man who killed the man who freed the slaves. I don't know what to say.
I saw him once, at a fire. He gave me his coat. I'd have followed him anywhere.
You're the one who killed the Anti-Slaver. It must be a heavy thing to carry.
Tinfist is dead and the roads are less safe for it. Whatever you thought, I wish you had thought longer.
A great man died at your hand. Stranger, I don't know who you are, but I know what you did.
You have Tinfist in chains. A man who freed a thousand slaves, in your chain. Shame on you.
Release him or I'll break every one of those links with my teeth.
Tinfist in your chains. Twist a link and I'll break your hand. Twist two and I'll break the rest.
Release the Anti-Slaver. Release him now, or I'll make you wish you had never learned his name.
Whatever you're doing to him, stop. Stop, or die as slowly as you can manage.
Chains do nothing to a skeleton who has been in them before. I'll wait.
I don't hold hatred, jailer. I hold a very firm objection.
My teacher held that a life must never be taken. You're testing that. I'm trying to pass.
You may hold my body in a cage. You can't keep the idea. That's already out.
The Preacher in Stormgap, wanted by three nations, and still feeds his moons. What does that tell you?
Don't go near the Cult Village. They tie strangers to poles. They don't ask first.
Blood rain, says the cult. I've never seen blood fall from the sky. I've seen what they do to make it.
Stormgap farmers are afraid. Don't ask what of.
The cult's Preacher wants moons to rain blood on the crops. The cult wants harvest. Neither will get what they want.
The Preacher is dead. The Cult Village is a quiet place now. The moons don't sing.
Three nations wanted him and a stranger did it. The Cities won't pay, but the farmers will be grateful.
The cult will go on. Fools always find another preacher. But the hand that held them is cold.
Stormgap sleeps easier. I wouldn't go there to check.
The Preacher is dead. The moon-cult sings no more. May the villages enjoy it while it lasts.
Heard the Preacher fell. Something about moons. I don't follow cults, so I didn't follow the news.
A cultist king dead in the coast. The coast has had worse.
The Preacher is gone and the poles are empty. That's all anyone is saying.
Heard a cult leader died on the coast. Cult leaders always do.
The Preacher is dead. Some say that means the end. Some say it means a new start.
Someone killed a madman with a following. This surprises no one but his followers.
Moon man dead. Moon people wail. Wail loud, wail /CANNIBALTASTY/.
Coast man dead. Cult scatter. Scattered meat easy meat.
Moon cult no leader. /CANNIBALCURSE/. Too crazy, even for us.
Preacher dead. /CANNIBALHA/. Who tell dhe moon people what to do now?
They took the Preacher alive. Three nations want him. One stranger holds the key.
A cult leader in chains. His moons are silent. I should be celebrating, but I have a bad feeling.
The Preacher in chains and the moon-cult whispering. They'll come looking, and they'll come soon.
They caught the cult leader alive. The bounty is excellent. The risk is hard to price.
A madman captured, and his flock still out there. I wouldn't want to be his jailer.
The one who ended the Preacher. The coast owes you its sleep. I don't owe you a thing, but I'll nod.
Three nations have wanted that head for years. You took it. Does it feel as heavy as it looks?
You ended the Preacher. The coast is quieter. Quiet is a kind of thanks.
The cult's head is gone and you are the reason. Do not wait around for the congratulations. The cult may disagree.
The moon-cult is headless and you're the axe. Don't wait for the thanks.
Arc hasn't lost a duel in the fog. Not once. Don't ask me how many I've seen.
The Fogmen come in the night and Arc is already awake. He sleeps with a sabre and a prayer.
Nobody remembers where Arc came from. Everybody remembers who he is.
I once saw Arc end a duel before the other man finished drawing. Whether that's the full tale, I couldn't tell you.
Arc keeps the town because nobody else wants it as much as he does.
Arc of Mongrel, they say, wields the sabre like a legend. The Shek call him slander and sharpen their axes.
Mongrel is out in the fog and only desperate men go there. They have Arc. I should like to meet him sometime.
A swordsman so good the Stone Golem wouldn't squash him. The Shek say it but they don't mean it.
Refugees go to Mongrel. Arc lets them in. That's all I know of him, and it's more than most.
Arc keeps his blade clean and his word cleaner. Mongrel is safe because of it, for now.
Arc is dead. The sabre is silent. The fog is quiet. I don't know what to do with my hands.
A town with no sword is a town in fog. Mongrel won't hold without him.
The Shinobi are standing guard, but their eyes keep going to his door.
He kept the Fogmen off our doorstep. Now we're all doorsteps.
I won't say who did it. I'll say that when I find out, I'll have a sabre in my hands, and I don't know how to use it.
Arc of Mongrel is dead. So the swordsman was only a man.
A legend, killed. The fog is quiet where Mongrel was. I don't know what comes next.
The refuge in the fog has lost its sword. I wonder how long the fog will honour it.
Arc of Mongrel is dead. The fog has one less legend and one more grave.
I heard Arc died with his blade in his hand. I'm inclined to believe it. It's a good story.
Mongrel's guardian is dead. I wonder who the refugees will run to now.
Arc is taken. The great swordsman in chains. Mongrel is holding its breath.
Whoever has Arc has the town's heart. Don't do something stupid, stranger.
Arc is captured. The fog thickens. Mongrel is unsure whether to wait or fight.
The swordsman in irons. I never thought I would see the day. I never wanted to.
Arc taken, and Mongrel waits like a held breath. Don't make it let go.
You killed Arc. A man who gave us shelter.
Murderer. Arc held this town and you cut him down.
Arc is dead. Arc is dead and you're here. I don't know what we did to you.
You killed the man who kept us alive. The fog will remember your face.
Arc is dead and you stand there. There is a word for that, and it is not kind.
You're the one who killed Arc. Whatever the reason, Mongrel will remember. The fog will remember.
I heard you outfought the best sabre in the fog. I hope you enjoy the victory.
You killed Arc? Then the fog has a new danger and the refuge has a new rumour.
